en: Black‑and‑white view of a European hilltown with a large baroque/early modern castle‑like building on a wooded hill, topped by a short dome or cupola. Below the hill sit several three‑story townhouses with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows, surrounding a small park or square with trees and a decorative fountain or monument in the foreground. The scene is framed by wooded hills in the distance. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.
